description: Common sense shows that Trump's economic policies have been an utter disaster for the United States of America. In particular, one of the worst policies of the Trump Administration for Montana has been the trade war with Canada. As a candidate for office, I have personally talked to voters who have been harmed by Trump's trade war with Canada, because Montana does a substantial amount of business with our Canadian neighbors to the north.
